raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Purpose `:amd: (MI300) Language Models (Extended Generation)` lost its pod (exit -7, "Perhaps the container was OOM-killed?") in 3 of its last 5 runs: [amd-ci#15340](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/15340), [amd-ci#15350](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/15350) and [amd-ci#15384](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/15384). Each time, the pod was killed during `test_granite.py::test_models[5-64-bfloat16-ibm/PowerMoE-3b]`. The tests in `tests/models/language/generation` load many checkpoints in one pytest process, and their page cache is charged to the pod's memory cgroup. The job reads ~208 GiB of checkpoints against ~133 GiB of effective pod memory, so even passing runs drop below 1 GiB of available RAM. This PR adds an autouse fixture in this directory that frees the previous test's checkpoint page cache when the model changes, using the same mechanism #61415 added for LM Eval. It applies on ROCm only. Consecutive tests of the same model keep its cache, as do the HF and vLLM runners within one test. ## Test Plan MI300X (gfx942), in the `rocm/vllm-dev:ci_base` image. The run used 24 of the job's 76 tests (~89 GiB of checkpoints), evicted the page cache before each run, and sampled the container's cgroup memory every 2 s: ```bash cd tests pytest -v -s models/language/generation/test_common.py models/language/generation/test_granite.py \ -m '(not core_model) and (not hybrid_model)' \ -k 'Qwen3-8B or stablelm or starcoder2-3b or Apertus or Domyn or PowerLM or PowerMoE or granite-swash' ``` ## Test Result The log shows `Released X GiB of checkpoint page cache` lines as the model changes. | | main | this PR | |---|---:|---:| | Peak container memory | 102.4 GiB | 28.5 GiB | | Peak page cache | 93.4 GiB | 19.8 GiB | | Duration | 21:16 | 21:52 | AI-assisted tooling was used to analyze the CI logs and to run the validation. The results and the change were manually reviewed. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

detail.title: [ROCm][CI] Release checkpoint page cache between language generation …

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Pytest configuration for vLLM language generation tests."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import drop_checkpoint_cache
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+_previous_model: str | None = None
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def release_previous_checkpoint_cache(request):
+    """Free the previous test's checkpoint page cache when the model changes.
+
+    Page cache counts against the container's memory cgroup, so on ROCm CI the
+    checkpoints these tests read would otherwise fill the pod's memory limit.
+    """
+    global _previous_model
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return
+    callspec = getattr(request.node, "callspec", None)
+    model = callspec.params.get("model") if callspec else None
+    if not isinstance(model, str):
+        return
+    if _previous_model is not None and _previous_model != model:
+        drop_checkpoint_cache(_previous_model)
+    _previous_model = model
